audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian — Lucian owning level 6, first item and 2+ items — against a 53.5% Shen win rate, the packet chart, and the already-audited mirror which set Skill / Lucian / Lucian / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen.
audit.why: Lucian's window is levels 2-3, before Spirit's Refuge and Shadow Dash are both online. From 4 onward Shen's W blanks the double-shot and every item Shen buys widens the gap; Stand United removes the lane's relevance at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 5, 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs to the packet chart; ratings raised to 5/10 on the Skill row and 6/10 on the four Shen rows; overall difficulty dropped from 8.5/10 to 6/10 to stop the page calling a 53.5% lane 'Hard'.

audit.why: spikes[] already tracks the real shape: his 1-2 poke window, Shen's level 3 answer, Stand United at 6, and the first-item tank spike. Entry count and timings left as they are.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] states Relentless Pursuit is 'on a 14-second cooldown' and wants.foe[1] says 'his E resets on cast'. Neither is right.
audit.why: Riot: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 — 14s only at rank 5 — and it does not reset; Lightslinger attacks REDUCE its cooldown. That makes blocking his double-shots with Spirit's Refuge a dash-denial tool, which the page never says.
audit.corrected: whys[3] gives the rank-1 16s and ties Spirit's Refuge to keeping his escape down; wants.foe[1] states the Lightslinger reduction instead of a reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] frames level 1 as Lucian's free window when the chart and packet call it even.
audit.why: Piercing Light is a 9s cooldown at rank 1 and he has no dash yet, so there is no follow-up on a landed poke.
audit.corrected: whys[0] rewritten around the 9s Q and the absent dash.

audit.why: missingInteractions claims Lucian can cancel Stand United with Lightslinger, and his passive carries hardCC and heal flags. Riot's own passive text has no CC and no self-heal — it triggers WHEN a nearby enemy is immobilized and when an ALLY heals or shields him. Per the trust-the-description rule I wrote neither the channel-cancel line nor an anti-heal line.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 6/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: Lucian's Piercing Light pokes through the wave with no risk — you have no taunt or shield yet, so position behind minions and farm without committing.
edits.after: Piercing Light is a 9s cooldown at rank 1 and pierces the wave — but with no dash yet he cannot punish; hold behind minions and the level is even.

edits.before: Your W-block and E-taunt combo is fully online and his dash cooldown is 14 seconds — every time Relentless Pursuit is down you can force a trade he cannot escape.
edits.after: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and only his Lightslinger double-shots cut it down — deny those with Spirit's Refuge and his escape stays on cooldown.

edits.before: Keep range and dash away immediately after poking — his E resets on cast so he can always put distance between you and your taunt
edits.after: Keep range and dash out after poking — every Lightslinger double-shot he lands shaves Relentless Pursuit back toward ready

notes: Two derived-flag misfires on Lucian's passive: hardCC and heal. Riot's Lightslinger text describes triggers (a nearby enemy being immobilized by someone else, an ALLY healing or shielding him), not Lucian applying CC or healing himself. missingInteractions built a 'Lucian cancels your Stand United' and a 'needs-antiheal' headline from those flags; I did not write either onto the page. Worth fixing centrally — every Lucian agent will hit the same two false headlines. Also unverified, matching the mirror: whether The Culling's shots count as attacks for Spirit's Refuge is not in Riot's text and I asserted nothing either way. carryRating left at 8.5/10 since the prose quotes it in several places; only difficulty was corrected.
